title: The Shining — A winter in an empty hotel

hook.quote: All work and no play makes Jack a dull boy.
hook.context: Bu eski ingliz maqoli: "Faqat ish, dam yo'q — Jekni zerikarli qiladi." Filmda Jack yozayotgan kitob o'rniga minglab sahifaga faqat shu gapni qayta-qayta yozgani ma'lum bo'ladi — eng qo'rqinchli sahnalardan biri.

reading: Jack Torrance was looking for a quiet place to write a novel when he got a job as the winter caretaker of the Overlook Hotel.
The hotel is high in the mountains and it closes every winter because the roads become impossible to use. Jack moves there with his wife Wendy and their son Danny.
While the manager was showing them the hotel, he mentioned something strange: years ago, a previous caretaker had gone mad there.

Danny has a special ability called "the shining". He can see things from the past and the future. While he was riding his tricycle along the empty corridors, he saw two little girls who were not really there.
Every day Jack was sitting at his typewriter, but he wasn't writing a book. The silence and the isolation were slowly changing him.
One evening, while Wendy was walking through the hall, she looked at Jack's pages. She was shocked: he had typed the same sentence again and again.
As the snow was falling outside, the family realised that they were trapped, and that the hotel itself seemed to be alive.

grammar.title: Past Continuous va Past Simple: while / when
explain: **Past Continuous** (was/were + -ing) — o'tmishdagi ma'lum paytda **davom etayotgan** jarayon: At 9 p.m. Jack **was sitting** at his typewriter.
Uzoq jarayon + uni bo'lgan qisqa voqea: While Danny **was riding** his tricycle, he **saw** two girls. Uzoq — Past Continuous, qisqa — Past Simple.
**while** odatda uzoq jarayon bilan (while + Past Continuous), **when** ko'pincha qisqa voqea bilan: I was cooking **when** the phone **rang**.
Ikki parallel jarayon: While Wendy **was walking**, Jack **was typing**. Holat fe'llari (know, want, like) continuous olmaydi: I **knew** him (I was knowing emas).
